key_insight: BiToK-SD learns which token positions to distill via bilevel Top-K selection, so self-distillation is applied where it is most useful rather than uniformly across all tokens.
engineering_relevance: This offers a lightweight way to improve reasoning performance in compact LLMs without relying on external teacher models, making it attractive for resource-constrained deployment.
method: Formulate self-distillation as a bilevel optimization problem.
Use a differentiable threshold-based relaxation to approximate Top-K token selection.
Apply distillation only on the learned selected positions as the student policy evolves.
evidence_signal: The method was evaluated on mathematical reasoning benchmarks and achieved the best average performance among compared methods with only lightweight extra computation.
watch_item: The approach adds bilevel-optimization and selection hyperparameters, so stability and efficiency may depend on careful implementation and tuning.
paper_title: Learning What to Distill: Bilevel Top-K Token Selection for Self-Distillation in Large Language Models
